# Case: test plan

Version 1.0.0 of the specification: 5 design tests, 2 golden and 3 red, about 2 subjects. Golden tests show a path that succeeds, red tests a path that is refused. The test cases follow the test case specification of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3.

## 1. Levels and how the tests run

| Level | Design tests |
|---|---|
| system | 5 |

System and acceptance tests are design tests, written in the specification and run by every implementation. Unit and integration tests belong to one implementation and are listed with it below.

## 2. Test cases

### Operation getHealth

#### get-health-succeeds

Scenario: golden; level: system.

- Given: any caller
- When: getHealth is called
- Then: it answers 200

#### get-health-unknown-path

Scenario: red; level: system.

- Given: a request for a path below /health
- When: getHealth is called
- Then: it is not answered by getHealth

### Gateway api

#### api-forwards

Scenario: golden; level: system; covers forwarded to loans, forwarded to catalogue.

- Given: a serviceAccess token whose aud is a value of the forwards
- When: a request no operation answers reaches the gateway api
- Then: it reaches the service the value names as received

#### api-refuses-tokens

Scenario: red; level: system; covers refused with no token, refused with a bad signature, denied with expired serviceAccess.

- Given: no token, a badly signed one or an expired one
- When: a request no operation answers reaches the gateway api
- Then: it answers 401 token-invalid

#### api-dependencies-fail

Scenario: red; level: system; covers dependency fails identity, dependency times out identity, dependency fails loans, dependency times out loans, dependency fails catalogue, dependency times out catalogue.

- Given: a dependency fails or does not answer in time
- When: a request no operation answers reaches the gateway api
- Then: it answers 502 service-failed

## 3. Derived cases left out

2 cases the design implies have no test and are not written by default: none is about a subject that satisfies a requirement with a harm, none is a case nobody exercises by hand (a failing dependency, two writers on one record), and none is a mistake users make often. Writing a test that covers one removes it from this list.

| Subject | Case | Scenario | Why it is left out |
|---|---|---|---|
| gateway api | refused with an unknown aud | red | occasional case, and gateway api satisfies no requirement with a harm |
| gateway api | refused with a aud naming two forwarded services | red | rare case, and gateway api satisfies no requirement with a harm |
